top_strength: Jules gathered most logistics details methodically (bedroom count, bed size, appliances, floor/stairs, weight limits, box count range, packing preference) and provided clear, accurate pricing with transparent hourly rate, minimum, and increment structure.
coaching_note: You skipped the two-concerns question entirely and jumped straight into logistics, missed both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage), never asked for the business, and did not attempt to close — when the customer said they'd call back, that was your moment to lock the rate, remove friction, and ask directly for a yes.
